DRAFT RELEASE NOTES — Introduction to Go 1.20

Go 1.20 is not yet released. These are work-in-progress release notes. Go 1.20 is expected to be released in February 2023.

Changes to the language

Go 1.20 includes four changes to the language.

Tools

Cover

The go test -cover command now prints the total coverage before exiting. It’s documented in the command documentation.

  • Coverage summaries can be collected for programs that are not tests.
  • The coverage command added:
    • a percent function
    • a func output mode
$ go tool cover -func
main.go:8:		main		100.0%

Core library

archive/tar

When the GODEBUG=tarinsecurepath=0 environment variable is set, Reader.Next method will now return the error ErrInsecurePath for an entry with a file name that is an absolute path.

New crypto/ecdh package

Go 1.20 adds the new crypto/ecdh package.

unsafe package & generics

The unsafe package defines three new functions SliceData, String and StringData.
